content_pillars: mental strength and personal development grounded in psychology
psychology of modern life and digital behaviour

episode_visual_targets.long_form_ai_generated_stills: about 5–7 when OpenAI image generation is enabled and the story benefits from them
episode_visual_targets.long_form_original_diagrams: about 3 topic-specific diagrams; add more only when the explanation genuinely needs them

note: Editorial targets guide creative production; they are not YouTube monetization guarantees or fixed visual quotas.

shorts_editorial_rules.positioning: fast, cinematic psychology explainers; distinct from long-form documentary edits
shorts_editorial_rules.script_word_guidance_at_140_wpm: approximately 70–140 words for the preferred 30–60 second cut; actual duration is determined by rendered narration
shorts_editorial_rules.opening: start immediately with a specific curiosity gap, surprising observation, relatable moment or question; no channel intro
story_shape: one clear explanation or evidence-aware insight
one memorable takeaway or thoughtful closing question
shorts_editorial_rules.ending: finish with a complete thought; optional subtle WISE-LAB follow/next-video prompt only when it fits naturally

editing.visual_change_target_seconds: about 1–3 seconds when the narration and available footage support it; do not force cuts that weaken comprehension

shorts_editorial_rules.review: Check hook strength, first-frame clarity, caption safe areas, pacing, ending completeness, music balance, and whether every shot supports the narration.
